text: What is inside a hundred grams of mango?
We mean raw edible flesh, with the skin and stone removed.
That portion has about sixty calories, fifteen grams of carbohydrate, and one point six grams of fibre.
It also contains about thirty-six milligrams of vitamin C.
These are food-database averages, not an exact reading of every mango.
Start with the portion, then understand the nutrients.
